name: @airprompter/agent-sync
description: Pull and hold AirPrompter agent releases: signed pull-only updates, the encrypted restart-safe slot store, key providers, the apply policy and its windows, and the daemon client.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
